definition: Dirk Lewandowski (born 1973) is a German professor of information research and information retrieval at the Hamburg University of Applied Sciences, Germany.
details: He also serves as an interim professor of data science at the University of Duisburg-Essen.
story: Think of a referee whose job is to be completely honest about who touched the ball last. Before trusting a machine, someone has to measure how good it really is — fairly and honestly. It is the exam that separates “it sounds good” from “it actually is good”. What gets measured is what actually gets better. That shared ruler is Dirk Lewandowski.
